summary_en: 1.665–1.8M shares, ¥250/share, Aug 14–Sep 10, 2026. Offeror 桃の木 holds 1.84M shares (22.38% post-split). Tender will lift offeror stake to 42.63–44.27%. Board recommends tender; shareholders' choice neutral. Listing on TSE Standard market to be maintained post-closing.

summary_en: Momo no Ki, current 22.38% shareholder, to launch tender offer for 1,665,000 CAPITA shares (20.25% S/O) held by KMO Capital LLP. Tender offer period: Aug 14–Sep 10, 2026 (20 business days). Tender price not disclosed in announcement. KMO is CAPITA's second-largest shareholder; CAPITA director Kitabe Sota serves as KMO member.
summary_jp: 桃の木による公開買付け開始。KMO キャピタル保有のCAPITA株1,665,000株（20.25%）を対象。公開買付期間は2026年8月14日～9月10日。公開買付価格は未定。
